tests.name: All tokens reachable (no filtering)
tests.code:
import torch
logits = torch.zeros(5)
seen = set()
for i in range(200):
    torch.manual_seed(i)
    seen.add({fn}(logits.clone()))
assert len(seen) == 5, f'Only saw {seen}'

tests.name: Returns valid index
tests.code:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(0)
V = 100
logits = torch.randn(V)
for _ in range(20):
    t = {fn}(logits.clone(), top_k=10, top_p=0.9)
    assert 0 <= t < V, f'Token {t} out of range'
